stage: M2 development pilot; no claim of an independent new vision method
question: Does learning structure with a physical-response loss improve unmeasured responses beyond image-only learning and direct response regression?

data.source: InverseBench public inv-scatter-train LMDB, 10000 physical contrast images
data.split_rule: NumPy default_rng(seed).permutation(10000): first8000 training, next1000 validation, last1000 internal assessment
data.official_validation: 10 previously inspected development objects; separate external-to-this-training diagnostic only
data.pretrained_prior_overlap: Public DAPS prior was trained on all10000 images. Internal assessment is unseen by these new networks, but is NOT independent of that pretrained prior; do not use it for a fair DAPS generalization claim.

observation.noise: circular complex Gaussian sigma=1e-4; real/imag std=sigma/sqrt(2)
observation.feature: linear Tikhonov image f0=A^T(AA^T+lambda I)^-1 y, lambda=1e-5 ||A||^2; float64 Cholesky, float32 cached map
observation.feature_parameter_basis: Fixed before this learning pilot from the previously completed M1 public-development Ridge grid; not chosen on the new internal assessment
observation.test_time_inputs: noisily observed field and known operator only

queries: all15 (wave4/6/8 x5 contiguous angular bands); raw physical predictions, no image clipping in forward

models.name: image
models.loss: mean image squared error divided by training pixel variance

models.name: direct
models.readout: positive15-dimensional head on decoded spatial features; no physical response operator in its loss

models.name: joint
models.readout: same exact differentiable physical query as image model

training.selection: validation only every200steps; image uses imageMSE, direct uses responseMSE, joint uses combined training objective; retain last and best checkpoints
training.precision: float32, TF32 disabled; no mixed precision in physical field power

report: image PSNR/SSIM for image and joint
full1000 internal assessment after checkpoint selection
interpretation: This is a controlled learning baseline and mechanism experiment. Adding a response loss or direct head alone is not claimed as novelty. Adaptive acquisition, calibration, unseen query transfer and real-data validation remain later experiments.
